page_title: BUR 1-3 NEW | Burnley v Newcastle 30/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Robert Jones has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Eddie Howe prepares a substitution. Joelinton is replaced by Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd).
90+3' 1 - 3 GOAL! Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 1:3.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' A substitution has been made. Florentino is replaced by Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye (Burnley).
88' Scott Parker has decided to substitute Lesley Ugochukwu and he is replaced by Ashley Barnes (Burnley).
82' Florentino (Burnley) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Robert Jones has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
80' Here is a change. Anthony Gordon is going off and Eddie Howe gives the last tactical orders to Jacob Ramsey (Newcastle Utd).
80' Substitution. Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Yoane Wissa walks off.
80' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar.

80' A huge opportunity wasted! Malick Thiaw (Newcastle Utd) produces a header from a rebound around the penalty spot. His effort is denied by one of the defenders who is well positioned and clears the ball to safety.
78' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) took the corner.
77' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. It will be a corner kick for Newcastle.
75' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Robert Jones blows for a foul.
74' Scott Parker decides to make a substitution. Loum Tchaouna will be replaced by Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley).
72' The referee signals a substitution. Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) is brought on as a substitute for Harvey Barnes.
72' Lucas Pires (Burnley) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post.
71' The attendance is 21020.
68' Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) rises above the defence inside the box, but his header flies narrowly wide of the left post.
62' Josh Laurent (Burnley) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a header which hits the crossbar!
59' Nick Pope pulls off a great save to deny Marcus Edwards (Burnley), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
56' CHANCE! Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
56' Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Nick Pope.
50' A precise low pass is received by Loum Tchaouna (Burnley), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
49' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
48' The corner is swung in but Burnley can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
48' Lucas Pires (Burnley) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
47' Lucas Pires (Burnley) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Burnley are awarded a corner kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Robert Jones has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
45+4' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
44' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
43' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
41' Marcus Edwards (Burnley) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.

41' What a chance that is! Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
40' Lovely run from Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
37' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Yoane Wissa (Newcastle Utd) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just over the bar.
36' A long pass, executed by Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
35' Yoane Wissa (Newcastle Utd) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

34' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but Martin Dubravka has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
33' Newcastle earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
32' Florentino (Burnley) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
31' A pass from Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is intercepted by Martin Dubravka and the move breaks down.
29' The corner is swung in and Yoane Wissa (Newcastle Utd) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker wide of the right post from close in.
29' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
28' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
28' Kyle Walker (Burnley) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
27' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders. The linesman makes the right call and Newcastle will have a corner.
27' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Newcastle force a corner. They send men into the box.
26' Referee Robert Jones points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Burnley players celebrate.
25' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Burnley players aren’t happy.

23' 1 - 2 Goal! Josh Laurent (Burnley) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot inside the left post. Armando Broja assisted in the goal. 1:2.
22' Marcus Edwards (Burnley) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the right post. Terrific solo effort, though.
20' The ball is cleared after Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
17' The linesman signals that Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
15' Problems for Scott Parker as Maxime Esteve is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Bashir Humphreys (Burnley) replaces him.
14' Maxime Esteve (Burnley) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
8' Referee Robert Jones signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Newcastle players have a reason to celebrate!
8' The goal for Newcastle is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
7' 0 - 2 Goal! The rebound fell to Yoane Wissa (Newcastle Utd) and he fired home from close range. The score is 0:2.
7' Yoane Wissa (Newcastle Utd) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
7' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) quickly picks up the rebound and drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. The opponent's goalkeeper pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
7' Great save! Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Martin Dubravka.
2' 0 - 1 Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home inside the right post. The goalkeeper was helpless.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Burnley will kick-off.
Robert Jones will supervise the game today.
